facts.text: Season 4 premiered Thursday, October 15, 2026, with all eight episodes released at once. Kate Wyler is double-crossed after President Grace Penn and VP Hal Wyler plan to seize a Russian nuclear weapon, and forms an alliance with First Gentleman Todd Penn (Bradley Whitford).
Creator Debora Cahn first developed a pilot set inside the US embassy in London in the early 2000s while working on The West Wing. Nobody bit, and she set it aside for almost 20 years.
Cahn credits Beth Jones, a former US ambassador to Kazakhstan, for reviving the idea. She called her "a superhero in a pantsuit," and the unassuming, fallible Kate Wyler grew out of that meeting.
Keri Russell was initially hesitant to take the role because of the upheaval it would bring to her life, so the series nearly ended after one season. Netflix has not announced a Season 5 renewal.
